privacy.title: Privacy and audience measurement
privacy.intro: This portfolio limits collection to what is needed to understand its use, monitor performance and answer messages sent voluntarily.
privacy.analyticsBody: Vercel Web Analytics measures page views and Speed Insights collects Web Vitals. The site adds no custom event and sends these tools no name, email address, message or wallet address.
privacy.contactBody: The name, email address and message entered are sent to EmailJS only to deliver the message. The site does not use them to build a profile or populate a database.
privacy.externalBody: Mapbox, Alchemy RPC providers and price sources are contacted only when the corresponding features are used. Those providers’ policies then apply to their services.
privacy.controlBody: You can browse the editorial pages and follow the RSS or Atom feeds without completing the form, sharing an email address or connecting a wallet. The site currently offers no newsletter sign-up. Content blockers may prevent Vercel measurements without blocking the main content.
privacy.contact: For any question about this processing, use the portfolio contact form.
